test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The first woman to swim the English Channel was __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**an American.**__

__
 
• **Gertrude Ederle of the United States **at the young age of 19 years, became the first woman to swim across the English channel.
 
• She swam 21 miles in her second attempt from **Dover, England.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arati Saha was the first Indian swimmer to cross the English Channel in 1959.
 
• In 1960, she became the first Indian sportswoman to be awarded the Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian honour in India.
 
• She was inspired by the ace Indian swimmer Mihir Sen.
 
• Mihir Sen was the first Asian to swim across the English Channel.
 
• English channel connects the North Sea to the Strait of Dover.
 
• Mihir sen is also the first swimmer to swim across Palk strait.
